services.desc: Our custom “Bohicket Boat Club App” conveniently schedules reservations and launches, as well as add-on “Club Concierge” services including reservation of water toys, ice, food, beverages, and more! Lowest “Member-To-Boat Ratio” in town = the best opportunity for fun on the water! Access to our other local Boat Club locations to experience the Lowcountry waterways. Other clubs and franchises require expensive initiation fees to join, Bohicket Boat Club membership requires NO UP FRONT
